content.short: UniversalX is the first chain-agnostic trading platform that lets you buy tokens from any chain without bridging.
content.description: UniversalX enables chain-agnostic trading by letting you deposit assets on any supported chain and purchase tokens on any other chain. Instead of moving funds across networks, your balances across all connected chains are pooled together to fund a single token purchase. For example, separate holdings of 1 ETH on Base, OP, and Base can be treated collectively as 3 ETH to buy a token in one transaction. This design lets you trade across chains without performing any cross-chain bridges, simplifying multi-chain investing and reducing friction.
content.meta: UniversalX enables chain-agnostic trading, allowing deposits and purchases across chains. Discover UniversalX and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
